segments.contextAfter: Discussion

Calling this convenience method is equivalent to calling the [`move(to:transform:)`](cgmutablepath/move(to:transform:).md) method with the first value in the `points` array, then calling the [`addLine(to:transform:)`](cgmutablepath/addline(to:transform:).md) method for each subsequent point until the array is exhausted.
